This [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|'''clone naval''']] '''[[Captain/Legends|captain]]''' was stationed aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. When it was attacked by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] boarding party, he reported the arrival of Separatist [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|boarding ships]] to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]].
